chunks: And if he were to cast forth his excuses.

key_terms.مَعَاذِيرَ: excuses or justifications offered to defend oneself

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the excuses of disbelievers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the finality of divine judgment where superficial justifications (ma'athir) offered by the disbeliever are rendered void by the weight of their deeds. It reflects the concept of 'Hajr' (sealing) on the heart, where excuses no longer hold merit because the truth has become manifest and undeniable before Allah. This moment marks the transition from the stage of trial to the stage of recompense, emphasizing that mere verbal defense cannot counteract the reality of one's spiritual state.
